issues.description: Tiny extraction still unconditionally requires external story manifest/files, so a clean checkout cannot run the advertised demo.
Default config points at data/stories, but the repository contains no story files to satisfy extraction.
Story loading has no fallback, count validation, or aggregated error reporting, causing late hard failures on the first missing file.
Validation loads vector metadata but instantiates the backend from CLI config without checking model/backend/dimension compatibility.
Preference steering can silently compare saved vectors against a different backend because artifact manifest compatibility is not enforced.
HF preference scoring uses a single-activity good-minus-bad logit, not the documented pairwise preference logits used for Elo.
Preference scoring assumes ' good' and ' bad' encode to usable first tokens, which can produce model/tokenizer-specific wrong scores.
If tokenizer offsets are unavailable or matching fails, steering falls back to modifying every prompt token instead of only activity tokens.
HuggingFace model and tokenizer downloads are unpinned, making full runs non-reproducible and vulnerable to upstream revision changes.
Config loading performs no schema or range validation, so invalid emotions, counts, thresholds, and backends fail late or produce bad artifacts.
Diagonal/off-diagonal summary logic has no guard for empty scenarios or single-emotion configs, leading to NaN metrics.
PCA threshold 0 still selects one component, contradicting the stated variance-threshold semantics.
Artifact writes overwrite files in place without atomic writes, so interrupted runs can leave mixed or corrupt outputs.
Integration coverage checks mostly file existence and one boolean, missing shape, manifest, backend, and numerical sanity assertions.
The test target assumes pytest and runtime dependencies are already installed, so it is not a reliable clean-environment test command.
